observations.why: The collective 'we' with a decisional 'adopting' enacts a binding organizational choice — a hierarchical decision performed as settled fact for the group.
The proportional speed comparison frames the choice in cost-benefit terms — quantified performance gain as justification.
A timeline declared as settled fact enacts authority-ranking — a schedule imposed on the organization without consultation or negotiation.
The summary re-presents the decision and its proportional justification in a structured format — authority-ranking (decision recorded) layered with market-pricing (quantified benefit).
